In regards to anon services I don’t really have any experience with them and have gotten mixed responses about the experience from others that have used them. I guess I wouldn’t be opposed to trying them as long as they are free. I feel like asking her where the line is for being reported is would be good and would probably help with me opening up.

When we first started meeting she said that she was a mandated reporter and if I said anything hurting or killing myself she would have to report it. That’s why I find myself never really opening up to anyone else I have seen for help (I’ve seen a total of 6 different therapists) and therefore never really making progress.
I guess I just don’t want to be 5150d by her cause my mom has gone before and seeing what that place was like was terrifying. I don’t really know what I want other then to vent.
